## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/kanban`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`KanbanComponent`](/api/kanban/KanbanComponent) | Component | A board of columns that cards move between, by dragging or with Control+Shift and the arrow keys (Command+Shift on macOS). |
| [`KanbanCardTemplateDirective`](/api/kanban/KanbanCardTemplateDirective) | Directive | Template for each card of a Kanban board. |
| [`KanbanColumnFooterTemplateDirective`](/api/kanban/KanbanColumnFooterTemplateDirective) | Directive | Template for the foot of each column of a Kanban board, below its cards, such as for an Add card button. |
| [`KanbanColumnHeaderTemplateDirective`](/api/kanban/KanbanColumnHeaderTemplateDirective) | Directive | Template for the header of each column of a Kanban board, in place of its title and count. |
| [`KanbanCardMoveEvent`](/api/kanban/KanbanCardMoveEvent) | Class | A card dragged, or moved with Control+Shift and the arrow keys, to a new place on a Kanban board: within its column or into another. |

### Types

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`KANBAN_DEFAULT_MESSAGES`](/api/kanban/KANBAN_DEFAULT_MESSAGES) | Constant |  |
| [`KanbanCardMoveEventOptions`](/api/kanban/KanbanCardMoveEventOptions) | Interface |  |
| [`KanbanCardTemplateContext`](/api/kanban/KanbanCardTemplateContext) | Interface | The context of a `monaKanbanCardTemplate`: the card, as `let-card`. |
| [`KanbanColumn`](/api/kanban/KanbanColumn) | Interface | A column of a Kanban board: the cards whose status field holds its `status`. |
| [`KanbanColumnTemplateContext`](/api/kanban/KanbanColumnTemplateContext) | Interface | The context of a `monaKanbanColumnHeaderTemplate` or `monaKanbanColumnFooterTemplate`: the column, as `let-column`. |

**Related types:** [`MonaKanbanMessages`](/api/i18n/MonaKanbanMessages), [`PreventableEvent`](/api/common/PreventableEvent)
